messages:
alex_cs: Heads up — enterprise POC (acct: acme-poc-77) says their free trial credits expired mid-loadtest. They did a big batch of calls, hit rate limits, and our webhook that should've extended the trial didn't fire. Customer is asking for a short extension so their QA run can finish. details they sent: request id `req_0a1b2c3d`, period 2026-03-16T22:10Z — can we look into logs and consider a manual top-up?

maria_support: thanks — can you paste the account id + approximate wall clock time? I'll ping billing once we have the data. did they open a support ticket? (:eyes:)

alex_cs: account id acme-poc-77, wall clock ~2026-03-16 22:09:30 UTC. yes, ticket #12452 opened by customer_josh. they attached curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","prompt":"load test"}'
```
They say responses started failing with 429 and then billing credits went to 0 while retrying.

priya_eng: I can pull the serving logs for that request id and time range. Quick Q: was this on Hosted or Dedicated for them? If hosted, we can check rate-limit enforcement and webhook retries. If dedicated, need their cluster id.

alex_cs: Hosted — they were on free trial hosted. no dedicated cluster.

priya_eng: pulling logs now — if webhook to billing failed, the auto-extension flow might not have triggered. Also want to check if retries consumed tokens due to repeated requests. I'll post findings shortly.

derek_billing: FYI policy: auto-extensions are best-effort. We can do one-off manual credit grants for POC customers. Need approval from billing manager for > $2000 equivalent. How large was the requested extension? what amount would cover remaining QA?

alex_cs: customer asked for "enough to finish the 2-hour run" — they estimated ~50k tokens. propose grant 60k tokens to be safe. estimated cost ~ $450.

maria_support: good, I'll escalate. @derek_billing can you approve a manual grant of 60k trial tokens? If approved, I'll do manual grant and update ticket.

derek_billing: approve 60k manual grant for acme-poc-77. I need a short note in the ticket explaining reason: webhook failure + rate limit retries consumed credits. Also cc finance for tracking. :white_check_mark:

ops_bot: [incident] webhooks.billing.delivery failed 03x between 2026-03-16T22:08:50Z and 2026-03-16T22:11:05Z — retry queued. Incident ID inc-20260316-09

priya_eng: verified webhook delivery failures during that window, root cause was transient 503 from billing-side endpoint (timeout on our side). Noted. We should mark this as customer-impacting. I'll open a follow-up with eng-infra to harden retries and alerting.

alex_cs: thanks all. maria, please confirm when grant is applied so I can close with customer. Also want to note we should proactively check other POCs that ran large batches that night.

maria_support: manual grant applied at 2026-03-16T22:43Z. updated ticket #12452 with note and CC'd finance + eng-infra. Customer notified and said :thumbsup:. Closing here unless anyone wants further action.

priya_eng: I'll file a runbook item for monitoring webhook failure windows and add an alert to flag high retry token consumption patterns.

derek_billing: fine. thanks everyone.

alex_cs: closing. thanks team! :tada:
